rationale: C19 plausibly supplied a material resignation-letter template: regretful acceptance is followed by an office-specific review of achievements, appreciation for Cabinet and interdepartmental service, anticipation of future consultation, and wishes for future health and happiness. The child preserves this sequence and several close formulations while adapting the achievements to the Commerce Department. C06 and C02 also share the delayed departure and future-assistance machinery, but their overall structures are less closely aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: during your six years as Secretary of Commerce... the specific new programs you have initiated and the others you have strengthened
shared_material.parent_excerpt: During the past three years... your contribution to the strengthening of our Social Security system, to the greater effectiveness of our public health activities, and to the better meeting of the educational requirements of our age
shared_material.explanation: Both move from accepting a Cabinet secretary’s resignation into a substantial, department-specific catalogue of accomplishments.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Certainly I shall not hesitate, should a need develop, to grasp your generous offer of future assistance.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There will be many occasions, I am sure, when we will have need to consult with you in the months ahead, and I am indeed grateful that you will be available for such continued assistance.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the substantive discussion by anticipating continued assistance or consultation after departure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: my very best wishes for your future health and happiness
shared_material.parent_excerpt: With warm regard and best wishes for your future health and happiness
shared_material.explanation: The closing wish is nearly identical and follows the shared future-consultation passage.
